description: This is a Go source file implementing command-line tools for document translation and internationalization (i18n). It includes parsing command-line flags, managing parallel and sequential processing of documentation files, and interface with translation memory and glossary systems.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point. Parses command-line arguments, sets up translation environment, loads resources, and dispatches processing of documentation files based on specified mode and concurrency settings.

methods.name: runDocSequential
methods.description: Processes document files sequentially, translating or skipping as needed, and reports progress.

methods.name: runDocParallel
methods.description: Processes document files in parallel using multiple workers, managing concurrency, error handling, and result collection.

methods.name: runSegmentSequential
methods.description: Processes document segments sequentially, translating or skipping each, with progress reporting.

methods.name: filterDocQueue
methods.description: Filters out documents that do not need translation based on existing translation memory and source hash comparison.

methods.name: resolveRelPath
methods.description: Resolves relative path of a file with respect to documentation root directory.
